title: Nu Deal's "Going Live" is amazing music that is ready for the world to enjoy in every way
htmlContent:
Nu Deal's "Going Live" is amazing music that is ready for the world to enjoy in every way. In every facet of music this record is stellar in every way. From the impressive vocal performance, and the production that sets the stage perfectly, the things to enjoy about this record are truly endless.
